title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato 8mm Film

alternative_titles.ja: 8mmフィルム版 宇宙戦艦ヤマト

synopsis:
A rare alternative compilation of Uchuu Senkan Yamato that was produced around 1977–1978.

Unlike the standard 1977 theatrical compilation movie, this 8mm film version features a unique edit and a completely new, exclusive narration track.

It received its first official public theatrical screening on October 6, 2024, during a special event celebrating the 50th anniversary of the Space Battleship Yamato franchise.
